description:
## Outcome

A future Windows package signs each required executable and DLL before the final ZIP checksum.

## Work

1. Inventory packaged EXE and DLL files that require signing.
2. Use an approved timestamped signing process.
3. Sign before ZIP creation and external checksum generation.
4. Verify certificate chain, timestamp, file identity, and trust after extraction.
5. Record signing evidence in release provenance.
6. Fail publication for an unsigned or changed required binary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All required Windows binaries verify after extraction.
- [ ] Signatures survive installation under spaces and non-ASCII paths.
- [ ] A changed binary fails verification.
- [ ] Final checksums describe the signed ZIP bytes.

## Tests

Run native Windows signature, timestamp, tamper, extraction, and artifact checks.

## Non-goals

Do not add a daemon, service wrapper, Scoop, Winget, or MSI.
title: Sign future Windows release executables
